definition.note: Genus-7 triply periodic 1-parameter family with rectangular period lattice, obtained by adding a handle to Batista's triply periodic Costa surface; limits are the singly periodic CHM(1,3) surface and the doubly periodic Scherk surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
